### vectordotdev/vector (timberio/vector)

### [`v0.62.0`](https://redirect.github.com/vectordotdev/vector/releases/tag/v0.62.0)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/vectordotdev/vector/compare/v0.61.0...v0.62.0)

The [COSE team](https://opensource.datadoghq.com/about/#the-community-open-source-engineering-team) is happy to announce Vector `0.62.0`! 🚀

[Vector](https://vector.dev) is a lightweight, ultra-fast tool for building observability pipelines that puts you in control of your data.

Thanks to the 18 contributors who made the 40 changes in this release:

- [6 breaking changes](https://vector.dev/releases/0.62.0/#breaking-changes)
- [3 new features](https://vector.dev/releases/0.62.0/#new-features)
- [8 enhancements](https://vector.dev/releases/0.62.0/#enhancements)
- [23 bug fixes](https://vector.dev/releases/0.62.0/#bug-fixes)

Upgrading to 0.62? Read the [upgrade guide](https://vector.dev/releases/0.62.0/#upgrade-guide).

[View the full release notes](https://vector.dev/releases/0.62.0/) · See upcoming releases on the [release calendar](https://calendar.vector.dev).
